public_audit_coverage.basis: Each new account is covered by a COMPUTED public diagnosis with exact ordered evidence and reconciled money PnL.

method_sources.usage: Adapted typed identity, common economic contract, benchmark equality and descriptive annual/holding/frequency helpers. No historical account result is read.

semantics.annual: Continuous year-end equity ratios; no annual reset.
semantics.holding: Positive-quantity account observations; not elapsed wall-clock exposure.
semantics.ignored_signals: Contemporaneous M005 while already held, including exit decisions; not independent trades or lost money.
semantics.paths: Changed exits change capital availability and subsequent entries; account delta is not the isolated effect on identical trades.
semantics.frequency: Complete overlapping 60-session windows with actual closed cycles; no forced terminal close.
semantics.goals: The five user-confirmed gates are evaluated simultaneously; technical PASS does not imply financial acceptance.

limitations: Repeatedly studied 2019-2025 development pool; no reserved 2026 results.
No original label mean is substituted for account PnL; no counterfactual skipped-trade simulation.
Fixed exits are representative hypotheses, not optimized parameters.
